kind: V2.0 integrated RTT: RTC-second sleep, tick compensation and runtime return

initial_failure.description: Timer0 enabled did not wake LPMCON bit0 sleep. No shell response after sleep; user RESET required. Electrical UART echo is not a shell response.
initial_failure.log:
msh />pmctl sleep


pmctl status

rtcctl status

version

fix: Use RTCCON bit7 independent RTC second wake. Align to prior RTC edge with scheduler running; mask IRQ and pause Timer0 only during LPM entry. Read RTC delta, set compensated tick and restore timer/IRQ policy; expired timers run on next normal tick.
